world.inspect_object.speaker: Narration
world.inspect_object.text: You study the {label}. Wind comes in from somewhere in Cuiling.

world.miniboss_cleared.speaker: Narration
world.miniboss_cleared.text: Only a clear breeze here now. The trial is over.

world.scar_cleared.speaker: Narration
world.scar_cleared.text: The scarred ground has stopped pulsing. A little grey-green pushes up through the burnt cracks — like a wound scabbing over.

world.scar_cleared.speaker: Thought
world.scar_cleared.text: The appetite closed. I didn't feed it.

world.mirror_cleared.speaker: Narration
world.mirror_cleared.text: One reflection left in the mirror hall: yours. The crack of the shortcut is still there, but it no longer glows.

world.mirror_cleared.speaker: Thought
world.mirror_cleared.text: The true shadow is heavier — then I'll walk with the weight.

world.wreck_cleared.speaker: Narration
world.wreck_cleared.text: The wreck has gone quiet. Waves knock at the keel like a water clock keeping time.

world.wreck_cleared.speaker: Thought
world.wreck_cleared.text: The captain sleeps. The pass was… making it ashore alive.

world.road_note.speaker: Notice Board
world.road_note.text: «No soup at the inn today. If you see a nest under the bridge, leave the eggs — the soft-feathered one belongs to a traveller.»

world.road_note.speaker: Notice Board
world.road_note.text: A newer line below: «The graveyard lamp went out. Whoever has fire, light it. Thanks.»

world.grave_b.speaker: Narration
world.grave_b.text: A bunch of dried wildflowers leans against the old stone. The wind turns the petals; a small copper coin holds them down.

world.grave_b.speaker: Thought
world.grave_b.text: Someone came. The village isn't entirely empty.

world.scare_field.speaker: Narration
world.scare_field.text: The scarecrow wears a child's cap, a patch sewn at the cuff. Half a dry biscuit sits inside the cap — for the birds, not for people.

world.scare_field.speaker: Narration
world.scare_field.text: Crooked letters on the brim: don't eat Wheatear's.

world.camp_ash_road.speaker: Narration
world.camp_ash_road.text: A traveller's embers are still warm. Stones beside them form an arrow: city to the east, smoke to the west.

world.camp_ash_road.speaker: Thought
world.camp_ash_road.text: Someone just left. Small footprints — in a hurry too, by the look of it.

region.mist_locked.speaker: System
region.mist_locked.text: The mist is still too far. Raise your sword at the knight fortress first.

region.dojo_warn.speaker: System
region.dojo_warn.text: The air in the dojo is heavy. Power 26+ recommended (you're at {power}). Try Veilfog first, or train up a few levels.

region.forest_warn.speaker: System
region.forest_warn.text: The forest wind runs fast. Power 30+ recommended (you're at {power}). The dojo or a hunting ground would toughen you up first.

region.coast_warn.speaker: System
region.coast_warn.text: The surf runs heavy. Power 30+ recommended (you're at {power}).
